detail: Dave approved the recommended option for every decision point in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-04-v2.0-prep-proposal.md, resolving the three 'proposed (pending approval)' decisions: (1) startup NUDGE over auto-migration, with TWINING_AUTO_MIGRATE=1 / storage.auto_migrate: true as explicit opt-in; (2) v2.0.0-beta under npm dist-tag next, never latest; (3) legacy-detection resolution rule for the default backend flip. Also approved: soft engines bump (no engine-strict, warn-and-fallback keeps old-Node sessions bootable), go-stable follows evidence gates (earliest ~mid-July 2026), SUPPORTED_CONFIG_VERSION=2 stamped at v2-migrate finalize. V6 (plugin pin bump to ^2.0.0) deferred to after stable.
